name: Xicotencatl II
contribution: A prince and warleader, probably with the title of Tlacochcalcatl, of the pre-Columbian state of Tlaxcallān at the time of the Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire.

checks.lead: Xicotencatl II Axayacatl, also known as Xicotencatl the Younger (died 1521), was a prince and warleader, probably with the title of Tlacochcalcatl, of the pre-Columbian state of Tlaxcallān at the time of the Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
